DeviceChain · dcctl bootstrap · instance acme ·
kind-devicechain · v1.11.0

Root-key escrow

DeviceChain encrypts stored credentials with this instance's
root key. Database backups do not contain it. To recover
after losing the cluster you need this escrow file and its
passphrase. Copy the file off this machine; keep the
passphrase separately.

› (*) Write an encrypted escrow file (recommended)
  ( ) Do not escrow the root key (--no-escrow)

  Location  /home/op/.devicechain/escrow/acme-rootkey.escrow
            default for this instance, on this machine,
            outside what 'dcctl destroy' removes

  You will be asked for its passphrase, twice, when the run
  reaches the escrow step, before anything is changed. Use a
  long unique passphrase from your password manager.
